name: Seespitz
beschreibung: Camping Seespitz (SonnenCamping Seespitz) is located directly on the western shore of the Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl region of Tyrol. Open all year round, the site offers panoramic views of the Kaisergebirge and has parcelled pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as a tent meadow close to the lake. The sanitary facilities, comprehensively renovated in 2020, include showers, lockable washing cubicles, a barrier-free area and a baby changing room. The private bathing beach with a sunbathing lawn features a bathing jetty, a water slide and a water trampoline. An on-site restaurant with a sun terrace provides catering, while a bread roll service and e-charging stations round off the offer. Walchsee village centre and a supermarket are around 300 metres away, and hiking and winter sports opportunities are available in the surrounding area.
kurzbeschreibung: Year-round campsite directly on the Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl, with renovated sanitary facilities, a bathing jetty, a restaurant and views of the Kaisergebirge.
